source_gap_claims.behavior: The validator must independently bind validator content, semantic-dependency closure, compatibility, support policy, and candidate-external trust; missing, substituted, escaping, drifted, incompatible, self-selected, forged-version, or always-success validators must fail closed.
source_gap_claims.reason: The proposed obligations cover only target existence/type/containment, package support, and VDD/Acceptance route preservation; they do not cover Validator Capability trust or dependency behavior.
source_gap_claims.subject: Validator Capability trust and dependency closure

source_gap_claims.behavior: Detached positive and negative Probes must execute as real independent processes, with the positive passing and the negative failing for its declared defect and expected diagnostic category; infrastructure failures cannot count as a negative result.
source_gap_claims.reason: No proposed obligation requires Probe execution, discrimination, bound inputs/outputs, or infrastructure-failure handling.
source_gap_claims.subject: Independent Probe discrimination

source_gap_claims.behavior: Frozen historical tracked membership, repository-relative paths, native command identity, and bytes must remain unchanged, with repair evidence append-only and historical evidence non-authorizing.
source_gap_claims.reason: The proposed obligations do not address historical immutability, native replay preservation, append-only evidence, or authority limits.
source_gap_claims.subject: Historical evidence preservation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Each of the three named evaluation seeds must occur exactly once with provenance, applicability, missing labels, counterexample or explicit absence, and an approved non-baseline classification.
source_gap_claims.reason: The proposed obligations contain no seed identity, cardinality, provenance, classification, or non-baseline requirements.
source_gap_claims.subject: Evaluation seed completeness

source_gap_claims.behavior: All six materially distinct Matrix Cases must execute both immutable Stable and Candidate subjects with distinct fixtures/state and attributable evidence; missing, copied, mislabeled, stale, reused, or non-executed evidence must invalidate the aggregate.
source_gap_claims.reason: The proposed obligations do not require Stable/Candidate subjects, six-case matrix execution, two-sided execution, or evidence isolation.
source_gap_claims.subject: Stable/Candidate replay matrix

source_gap_claims.behavior: The complete current Consumer Manifest must be reconciled against repository callers and every applicable Consumer must execute enable, disable, rollback, and re-enable through real call surfaces, restoring Prior Route identity and verdict/diagnostic baseline.
source_gap_claims.reason: The proposed obligations do not cover Consumer discovery, route invocation, rollback behavior, or prior-baseline restoration.
source_gap_claims.subject: Consumer route transitions and rollback

source_gap_claims.behavior: Every Atomic Obligation must have bidirectional Exact Cover to assertions, selectors, commands, witnesses, and runtime evidence, with no orphan requirements or evidence nodes.
source_gap_claims.reason: The proposed obligations contain no Exact Cover graph, bidirectional mapping, witness, or orphan-detection behavior.
source_gap_claims.subject: Exact Cover verification

source_gap_claims.behavior: Replay results must bind a complete Current Snapshot and reproduce from a fresh checkout; any unexplained result-determining input drift must make the result stale or fail closed.
source_gap_claims.reason: The proposed obligations do not cover snapshot identity, fresh-checkout reconstruction, reproducibility, or stale-input invalidation.
source_gap_claims.subject: Current Snapshot and semantic reproduction

source_gap_claims.behavior: Replay, seed, matrix, review, and Quick Dev artifacts must expose an empty machine-verifiable authorization set and cannot publish foreign lifecycle state; only the current Acceptance lifecycle owner may publish acceptance-passed.
source_gap_claims.reason: The proposed obligations do not cover non-authorizing receipts, lifecycle ownership, or foreign authorization rejection.
source_gap_claims.subject: Lifecycle authority boundaries

source_gap_claims.behavior: Writes to installed BMAD/GDS paths, Phase/runtime/Hosted workspace/account/sandbox paths, replacement TC-D1 requirement trees, and roadmap capabilities such as promotion, Miner/Curator, autonomous modification, ranking, or reinforcement learning must be rejected.
source_gap_claims.reason: The proposed obligations address target path containment only and omit the source's protected scope and roadmap boundaries.
source_gap_claims.subject: Protected scope boundaries
